## Historical audit: H0072, visible chunk 1 of 2

**Inferred goal:** add an automatic table of contents to Obsidian Linter. The full task specification is not visible, so its exact requirements cannot be established from the task name alone.

**Source for all event citations:** H0072, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_07/lanes/codex_parallel_07_lane4/codex_parallel_07_lane4_H_r1/infer_logs/obsidian-linter-auto-table-of-contents/turn_1/trajs.json`.

| Area | Visible evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Exploration | The student inspected repository structure and rule infrastructure. Creating a branch from `main` failed because the reference was invalid; it then created `auto-toc` from HEAD, which matched `master` (main agent events 1–8). It independently inspected rule registration, execution order, ignored Markdown types, options and existing rules (events 9–24, 27–42). |
| Baseline check | A script found `src/rules/auto-toc.ts` absent and printed that a marker could not generate a TOC (events 25–26). The file-existence check supports the absence of that named file, not an independent functional test of every possible TOC mechanism. |
| Changes | The student issued a Write for `src/rules/auto-toc.ts` (event 43). Its proposed content registers a specially ordered rule, finds TOC markers, scans headings while ignoring YAML, code and math, generates links and offers formatting, level and exclusion options. **The write result is not visible in this chunk**, so this event alone establishes the attempted write, not its successful completion. Inventory metadata reports a 10,175-byte patch, but its contents are not visible here. |
| Validation and outcome | No post-write test result is visible. Top-level metadata records `incomplete`, `CancelledError`, and a started task described as “Retry build and TypeScript verification” (top_level_metadata, characters [0,805)). Inventory reports evaluation missing. This is a **technical interruption with unknown correctness and formal outcome**, not evidence of a passing build, algorithm failure, or an empty patch. |
| Teacher input | Hint files and an actual-system-prompt path are listed as available in inventory metadata, but their contents and any delivered teacher event are not visible in this chunk. Receipt and adoption are therefore unknown; availability is not receipt. |

**Lessons and uncertainty:** The transferable observation is that inspecting registration, execution order and ignore handling can reveal integration constraints before implementation; the failed `main` lookup also shows why checking available references matters. The task-specific approach was marker-delimited TOC generation with heading filtering. Whether the written implementation handles all required Markdown and link cases, whether the write succeeded, and whether subsequent tests passed remain unresolved. Chunk 2 is not visible and is not inferred.
